evidence.observation: Growth pressure was 2.983 Torr at 100 sccm Ar and 750 °C setpoints.
Pressure rose to 3.025 Torr with unchanged setpoints.
Pressure reached 3.131 Torr, about 5% above the earlier growth baseline, despite stable Ar (100.6 sccm), temperature (750.4 °C), and heater power (44.7%).
Exhaust oxygen sensor is not installed; oxygen ingress cannot be assessed from this telemetry.

args.missing_evidence: Pressure tolerance or normal-run growth pressure trajectory, independent pressure verification, and leak/exhaust-conductance checks are needed to identify the pressure-rise cause. Sample characterization is not yet available.
